description.value: Sushi Island is an authentic Japanese restaurant in Victoria's Hillside neighbourhood, open since 2013 and built on a reputation for freshness through high turnover. The menu spans traditional sushi, sashimi, nigiri, hot pots, donburi, and Korean-influenced dishes. The casual modern interior suits a quick post-ride lunch as easily as a longer sit-down dinner.
